# openai_project_service_tier_settings (Data Source)

Read a project's default and enabled service tiers without changing them.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_project_service_tier_settings" "example" {
  project_id = "proj_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) project id

### Read-Only

- `default` (String) Default tier for requests that omit service_tier or use auto.
- `enabled_tiers` (Dynamic) The string "all" or a list of enabled optional tiers. An empty list allows only Standard.
- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier.
- `response_json` (String) Raw JSON response returned by the OpenAI API.
